objective: Find the longest raw UTF-16 prefix without changing the list or repeatedly copying candidates.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Indexed comparison remains current JavaScript practice.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Prefix selection is useful string/list work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Text units, ownership and bounded copying transfer to other scans.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: A dense bounded list keeps the nested-comparison objective focused.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Sorting input or retrying copied prefixes can corrupt data or add quadratic work.

defects: UTF-16 versus code-point semantics were unstated.
Junior accumulated an immutable prefix; senior repeatedly shortened and rechecked it.
An input-sorting function passed the old cases.
rationale: Keep the vertical reference; rewrite junior to track a length and slice once, and senior to compare shared lengths per word. Define unchanged dense/frozen inputs and raw UTF-16 semantics, including a possible surrogate-boundary prefix. Three assertions cover actual source order, supplementary/unpaired/null units, case/combining differences and 1000-by-1000 shared text. A horizontal alternative passes 585 native short-list comparisons with an independent startsWith oracle. Keep O(n · k) and O(1) auxiliary space excluding output. No TypeScript cases apply.

objective: Reverse exact non-whitespace runs under JavaScript delimiter semantics while preserving word text.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Splitting, scanning and joining remain current basics.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Normalizing separators is practical text work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Exact delimiters and preserved payload transfer to tokenizers.

defects: The split/filter hint could imply a literal-space split handles tabs.
The explanation incorrectly promised an empty list after empty-text split.
rationale: Keep all correct boards. Clarify whitespace-run splitting and trimming/filtering edge pieces; correct the empty-placeholder explanation. Define JavaScript whitespace, unchanged word content, Unicode/unpaired payload and one ASCII separator. Three assertions cover line breaks/NBSP/BOM, zero-width/NEL non-delimiters, exact case/punctuation and 1000 units/500 words. A right-to-left scanner passes 7381 native short-text comparisons with a non-whitespace-match oracle. Keep O(n) time/space; unsupported ranged copies stay unknown under #426. No TypeScript cases apply.

objective: Merge two unchanged ordered Number lists stably with fresh output and linear combined work.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Two-pointer merging remains a current foundation.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Combining sorted data is practical collection work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Stable ties and empty-side ownership transfer to other merges.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Bounded finite numbers keep traversal focused.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Returning an input aliases caller data; sorting discards existing order.

defects: The hint said exactly one remainder even when both inputs start empty.
Numeric/zero-tie and aliased-input semantics were implicit.
An empty-side alias passed old cases.
rationale: Keep the correct pointer boards; clarify at most one remainder. Define finite sorted/frozen inputs, fractions/signed zero, left-first ties, unchanged/aliased sources and fresh outputs. Three assertions cover zero signs, duplicates, same-array inputs, source/result/empty-side independence and 2000 output positions. A generator plus Array.from merge passes actual worker checks and 1225 native sorted-pair comparisons with an independent stable concatenation-sort oracle; the algorithm itself calls no sort. Preserve independent O(n + m) dimensions and output space. No TypeScript cases apply.
